atoms.text: Mr Waddle travels across to Asia, which is connected to Europe. Will you take him around Asia?

instruction.text: Can you point out Asia to Mr Waddle on the map?
Mr Waddle explores some Asian cities. Select the images of cities he might visit.

feedback.wrong: This is a county in the UK, which is in Europe.

instruction.text: Mr Waddle heard that Asia is full of interesting landscapes. Select the images of natural Asian landscapes.

feedback.end: Asia has a wide range of climates and natural landscapes. You can find dry deserts, tropical rainforests and open grasslands.
feedback.wrong: This is a street where people live in South America.

instruction.text: Mr Waddle visits the busy city of Tokyo in Japan. Find the tallest tower in the image to tell him a fun fact.

feedback.end: Asia is the most populated continent. It is home to over half of all the people on Earth.

instruction.text: Mr Waddle visits the Himalayas, which is a long mountain range in Asia. Answer his question.

hint.text: Mount Everest is the tallest mountain in the world at 8,800m above sea level. It is incredibly difficult to climb.
hint.label: Mount Everest

atoms.a: “I heard Mount Everest is here in the Himalayas. Do you think we can climb it in one day?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m8'>I heard Mount Everest is here in the Himalayas. Do you think we can climb it in one day?</voice>
